title: Create Legacy Hand Crank Fix
description: Try to fix a texture issue in Create Legacy.
body:
This Resource Pack only did one thing: tries to fix the transparency issue of Hand Crank's texture from [Create Legacy MOD](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-legacy).  
Problem with its model: I'm trying to find some way to fix it. I hope the author can fix this issue earlier than I can. XD
